components.text: PROCESS: 8 remote wells + 1 on-site well + 2 surface inlets → Cl2 / NH3 injection and chlorine monitoring → 5 GSTs → 6 booster pumps → distribution Cl2 / NH3 analyzer. Teal: well water • Blue: surface/treated water • Gold: Cl2 • Violet: NH3. Flow markers follow signed GPM. Select one scenario before reading the KPIs: All combines unrelated training states.

components.text: Training demonstration only. Equipment labels reflect a source schematic, but values, opening percentages, chemical concentrations, capacities, scenarios and alarms are synthetic. This is a process-connectivity visualization, not a calibrated hydraulic model, chemical-treatment design, or an operating/control procedure. Mass balance uses Q(source) − Q(booster) = Q(net storage), with positive values indicating filling.
